# Kola Copilot Instructions

Use `AGENTS.md` as the canonical project instructions.

Before editing, read:
1. `AGENTS.md`
2. `docs/PROJECT_STATE.md`
3. `docs/PROJECT_GRAPH.md`
4. Only the detailed spec relevant to the task

Every patch must update `docs/PROJECT_STATE.md`. Architecture/data-flow changes must also update `docs/PROJECT_GRAPH.md`. Durable decisions must update `docs/DECISIONS.md`.

Do not duplicate long project context here.
